issues.title: [Feature]: Add "Archive" option for agents
Raise or make configurable the 100 agent cap for local and private-server installs
[Feature]: Apple Watch companion: agent status and approvals from the watch
Bitwarden on this computer disconnects after a restart or an update
[Bug]: Grok usage-limit banner appears in every chat and does not clear on its own
[Bug]: After a channel lead timeout, the Coordinator assigns every later independent task to the one busy member
[Feature]: Add a Shopify MCP server
[Feature]: Option to turn off built-in agent memory (injection and remember tools)

[Bug]: Routines canvas marks Coordinator Done and omits Researcher while a delegated run is still open
Live per-step run status for all providers, and provider/model on web and mobile errors
[Feature]: Supported Hindsight integration for automatic retain and recall in signed desktop builds
[Bug]: A turn that fails before any output stays running forever and blocks the agent's queue (survives restart)
[Feature]: Setting to send only OpenBot's runtime protocol, without the built-in behavior and style instructions
MCP setup sign-in card is not shown in the mobile app (desktop only)
Mobile: long press should open message quick actions; emoji reactions render as black glyphs
